author: Tim
title: Fans Tear Up At Christina's Emotional Whitney Tribute
text:
Christina Aguilera gave fans an emotional night at the American Music Awards as she paid tribute to her idol, Whitney Houston. It was the 25th anniversary of The Bodyguard, and Christina was chosen to perform a medley of Whitney’s biggest songs.
She grew up singing Whitney tunes, even performing one at her first-grade talent show and later using another to get her first record deal. During the medley, Christina sang “I Will Always Love You,” “I Have Nothing,” and “Run to You,” and each one hit hard with the audience.
The crowd could feel how much Whitney’s music meant to her. The way Christina handled the range and emotion showed just how deep that connection ran. As one viewer said: “WOW. They picked the perfect person to do this tribute. God bless this woman.”
Fans flooded social media with praise and tears, saying it was one of the best Whitney tributes they had ever seen. Christina has performed Whitney songs before, including “I Have Nothing” and “I’m Every Woman” on The Voice finale in 2016. That show featured a hologram of Whitney, but it was later pulled when her estate said the hologram “looked nothing like Whitney.”
Christina has always said that Whitney was one of the main reasons she became a singer. She said: “Having [Whitney’s] songs on the audition tape was proof to the label that I could belt the specific high notes that they wanted to hear.” Watching her now, it’s clear that Whitney’s influence still lives in her voice and in her heart.
